entries.2b56adc00d845f86: The company purchases orthopedic products, including artificial joints, bone fixation materials and spinal fixation devices, from its U.S. subsidiary Ortho Development Corporation (ODEV) and from domestic and overseas manufacturers under sales alliance agreements, and sells them in Japan. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,109 million, making this the largest business of the company group.
entries.3a30429fb0f9458a: A company that develops and manufactures medical devices such as artificial joints and bone fixation materials in Japan and the United States, mainly in the field of orthopedics, and sells them to medical institutions.
entries.590b074d476882e0: A business in which the U.S. subsidiary ODEV develops and manufactures artificial joints, bone fixation materials, spinal fixation devices and others and supplies the products to the company, and also sells artificial joints, spinal fixation devices and others, mainly in the U.S. market. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥10,807 million.
entries.63dc920b3471fed3: Sells artificial joints used for total knee arthroplasty (TKA), total hip arthroplasty (THA) and other procedures, mainly in the United States. Nationwide rollout of the new product Trivicta Hip Stem is under way. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales in the United States were ¥10,774 million.
entries.6cadf61d4078bdef: Sells bone fixation materials in Japan, including Prima Hip Screw for femoral neck fracture treatment and ASULOCK for femoral trochanteric fracture treatment. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales in Japan were ¥4,444 million.
entries.6f1394abb8f3598a: Sells spinal fixation devices in Japan, including the KMC Kyphoplasty system and Pedicle Screw. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales in Japan were ¥3,493 million.
entries.8f7b7940114ee075: Sells spinal fixation devices in the United States. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales in the United States were ¥32 million.
entries.b743a7b9a335233a: Sells artificial joints used for total hip arthroplasty (THA), artificial femoral head insertion (BHA) and other procedures in Japan. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales in Japan were ¥4,904 million.
entries.c1ca14ddd99cf694: Medical institutions in the United States
entries.e67396feaba6490f: Medical institutions mainly in the United States
